message: No detected input validation: The code reads CSV files and pickle data directly without any schema checks, dtype assertions, or value-range guards on the incoming data.

No detected untrusted source handling: Data is fetched from a Dropbox URL via wget and models are loaded from HuggingFace Hub with no checksum verification, pinned revisions, or authentication checks.

No detected label flipping detection: The code uses a fixed label2int mapping and LabelEncoder but never validates that incoming labels match an expected set or checks for distribution anomalies indicative of label flipping.
No detected data poisoning defenses: There are no outlier detection, statistical anomaly checks, or any filtering mechanisms applied to training samples before they are consumed by the model.

No detected model integrity verification: Pretrained models and tokenizers are loaded from HuggingFace Hub (e.g., 'bert-base-uncased', 'distilroberta-base') without any hash verification, signature check, pinned revision, or controlled internal source.

No detected label distribution validation: The code reads CSV data and encodes labels but performs no class balance checks, expected-label-set validation, or anomaly detection on label distributions before training.
No detected backdoor or trigger detection: There is no neural-cleanse-style trigger detection, activation-pattern analysis, or gradient anomaly detection anywhere in the training loop.
No detected differential privacy: The code uses standard AdamW optimization with no Opacus, TensorFlow Privacy, or DP-SGD mechanisms applied.
No detected adversarial robustness testing: No adversarial attack libraries (Foolbox, ART, Cleverhans) or attack methods (FGSM, PGD) are imported or used anywhere in the code.

No detected metric tampering protection: Although separate train/val/test splits exist, there is no signing or hashing of evaluation data, no isolation enforcement, and the LabelEncoder is fit on each split independently (including test), which could cause label leakage; no multiple independent metric verification is performed.
No detected input sanitization: No input validation, schema checks, shape/range guards, or malformed-input rejection are present anywhere in the inference data-flow path.
No detected output bounds checks: Model outputs are consumed directly (logits passed to CrossEntropyLoss or returned as-is) with no NaN guards, probability sanity checks, or threshold validation.

No detected prompt injection defenses: Although the model processes text, there is no input filtering, system-prompt isolation, output content moderation, or jailbreak detection implemented anywhere in the code.
